sqlite_master.name: runtime_turn_item_link_insert_v1
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE TRIGGER runtime_turn_item_link_insert_v1 AFTER INSERT ON runtime_items BEGIN INSERT INTO runtime_turn_item_links_v1(id,agent,turn_id,created,epoch) VALUES (NEW.id,NEW.agent,json_extract(NEW.record,'$.turnId'),NEW.created,COALESCE((SELECT epoch FROM runtime_turn_item_link_state_v1 WHERE id=1),'')) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET agent=excluded.agent,turn_id=excluded.turn_id,created=excluded.created,epoch=excluded.epoch WHERE runtime_turn_item_links_v1.agent IS NOT excluded.agent OR runtime_turn_item_links_v1.turn_id IS NOT excluded.turn_id OR runtime_turn_item_links_v1.created IS NOT excluded.created OR runtime_turn_item_links_v1.epoch IS NOT excluded.epoch; END

sqlite_master.name: runtime_turn_item_link_update_v1
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE TRIGGER runtime_turn_item_link_update_v1 AFTER UPDATE ON runtime_items WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.agent IS NOT NEW.agent OR OLD.record IS NOT NEW.record OR OLD.created IS NOT NEW.created OR OLD.rowid IS NOT NEW.rowid BEGIN DELETE FROM runtime_turn_item_links_v1 WHERE id=OLD.id AND OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id; INSERT INTO runtime_turn_item_links_v1(id,agent,turn_id,created,epoch) VALUES (NEW.id,NEW.agent,json_extract(NEW.record,'$.turnId'),NEW.created,COALESCE((SELECT epoch FROM runtime_turn_item_link_state_v1 WHERE id=1),'')) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET agent=excluded.agent,turn_id=excluded.turn_id,created=excluded.created,epoch=excluded.epoch WHERE runtime_turn_item_links_v1.agent IS NOT excluded.agent OR runtime_turn_item_links_v1.turn_id IS NOT excluded.turn_id OR runtime_turn_item_links_v1.created IS NOT excluded.created OR runtime_turn_item_links_v1.epoch IS NOT excluded.epoch; END

sqlite_master.name: runtime_turn_item_link_delete_v1
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE TRIGGER runtime_turn_item_link_delete_v1 AFTER DELETE ON runtime_items BEGIN DELETE FROM runtime_turn_item_links_v1 WHERE id=OLD.id;  END

sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_payload_refs (
            table_name TEXT NOT NULL, record_id TEXT NOT NULL, field TEXT NOT NULL,
            sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(table_name,record_id,field))

sqlite_master.name: runtime_payload_refs_hash
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX runtime_payload_refs_hash ON runtime_payload_refs(sha256)

sqlite_master.name: runtime_payload_checkpoints_insert
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER runtime_payload_checkpoints_insert AFTER INSERT ON runtime_checkpoints BEGIN
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO runtime_payload_refs(table_name,record_id,field,sha256)
            SELECT 'runtime_checkpoints',NEW.id,j.key,json_extract(j.value,'$.sha256')
            FROM json_each(json_extract(NEW.record,'$._payloadBlobs')) AS j
            WHERE json_type(j.value,'$.sha256')='text';
        END

sqlite_master.name: runtime_payload_checkpoints_update
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER runtime_payload_checkpoints_update AFTER UPDATE OF record ON runtime_checkpoints BEGIN
            DELETE FROM runtime_payload_refs WHERE table_name='runtime_checkpoints' AND record_id=OLD.id;
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO runtime_payload_refs(table_name,record_id,field,sha256)
            SELECT 'runtime_checkpoints',NEW.id,j.key,json_extract(j.value,'$.sha256')
            FROM json_each(json_extract(NEW.record,'$._payloadBlobs')) AS j
            WHERE json_type(j.value,'$.sha256')='text';
        END
